heading: ## Root Cause
expected: `resolveEpicLineage` already supports `parentAuthoritativeBranch` and `parentAuthorityError`, but `merge-back.mjs`'s production `realGraphNode` supplies only numeric parent and child edges. It never reads the parent issue's durable worktree-location marker, so the resolver falls back to the canonical branch spelling even when authoritative custom-branch evidence exists.
replacement: `resolveEpicLineage` already supports `parentAuthoritativeBranch` and `parentAuthorityError`, but `merge-back.mjs`'s production graph adapter supplies only numeric parent and child edges. It never reads the parent issue's durable worktree-location marker, prefetches only the child node even though merge-back later resolves the immediate epic node, and then calls `parseBranchName(epicBranch).issue` to recover numeric identity from an intentionally opaque branch ref. A custom branch therefore either falls back to a nonexistent canonical ref or cannot be parsed after authority is supplied.
